name: music-puzzle-game
description: Interactive music-based puzzle game with Rust core and web frontend

scripts.dev: bun run build:wasm && concurrently "bun run build:wasm:watch" "cd puzzle-web && bun run dev"
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && cd puzzle-web && bun run build
scripts.build:wasm: cd puzzle-core && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../puzzle-web/src/wasm -- --no-default-features --features wasm
scripts.build:wasm:watch: cd puzzle-core && cargo watch -s 'wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../puzzle-web/src/wasm -- --no-default-features --features wasm'
scripts.test: bun run test:rust && cd puzzle-web && bun run test
